title: Hinomori Shiho — Sound & Calligraphy〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do we do...?!
We can't let Rin and MEIKO's amazing idea go to waste like this! We have to see this through for Hona's sake...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We'll blow everyone's cover if we don't do something...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Is something wrong...?
You all seem flustered...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, w-we just... Well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We weren't expecting you...
Cause you had to go to work, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Nice save, Shiho...!
Oh, she even managed to keep everything out of Honami's line of sight!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, I just wanted to ask about practice tomorrow before I did go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was wondering if we could focus on some of the parts that were giving me trouble. Something about them isn't clicking right in my head...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure.
It's probably best for us to nip that in the bud.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
I thought about just sending a message, but I really wanted to get it off my chest as soon as I could.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, see you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, see you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Bye bye, Hona!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Safe!!
That was amazing, Shiho!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought we were done for, but you found the perfect place to stand. Thank you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, I broke out in a cold sweat too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I wasn't about to let MEIKO and Rin's idea get ruined after agreeing to help them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm with you there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get back to writing out blessings for her!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah.
That was really good!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You stayed completely focused through all of it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Rin? MEIKO?
Why are you two grinning like that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Oh...
Is it done?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hona!
We made a special Omikuji just for you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't you try drawing from it? I'm sure you'll enjoy what comes out!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...
But you know my luck's terrible with these...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
This one's specially made by me! It's guaranteed to make anyone super duper happy with a cherry on top♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Since you personally made this, Rin, I might just have to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here we go...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Open it, Honami.
What did you get?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's... What?! A “great blessing”?!
I got a “great blessing”?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yay!!
Congratulations, Hona!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Congratulations, Honami!
Can you tell us what else is written?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
“Education: You'll be fine. (If anything, I'd like you to tutor me in math.)
Music: You're developing your very own sound while staying in perfect rhythm. Keep it up.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, she drew mine first...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did you write this...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I did...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's still lots more where that came from, Hona! Here, try drawing another one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Another “great blessing”!
“Travel: See the stars with your friends. (Another rooftop planetarium show could also be nice.)”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It'd be nice to do that together since we're all here now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that as well!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, this one's a “great blessing” too!
“Lost item: You won't have trouble finding it. (Also, thank you for helping me find my glasses.)” Is this yours, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, but having it read aloud is a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehehe. So many “great blessings”!
Oh, this must be Saki's! That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi's is really good too, so don't forget to draw it!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-You don't need to egg her on...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh! All according to plan!
I'm glad you like it so much, Hona♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
High five, Rin!
I have to think no one out there can top you in terms of ideas like these.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ You really mean that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I heard that you were put in a bit of a spot but managed to keep everything a secret. We really need to thank you for doing that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It wasn't anything major.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
I mean, just look at Honami.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you think we would've been able to see her smile like this if she did find out in advance?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Yeah, you might be right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Next is... A “super special great blessing”?! Oh, Rin, this must be yours, no?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Correct!
Keep reading♪ Keep reading♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (All I did was help out a little, but I'm glad we did this...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to another good year.)
